qset.question: What is the exact job title mentioned in the document?
Where is the Desktop Support Analyst role based?
Which team in Houston does the analyst coordinate with?
Is this position based out of Hyderabad, India?
qset.answer: No, it is based out of Bangalore, India

qset.question: What is the minimum number of years of experience required for the role?
What educational background is expected for the Desktop Support Analyst position?
qset.answer: BS or MS in Information Technology related field or equivalent experience of knowledge and experience

qset.question: Which operating systems and device platforms must the analyst be able to support?
Are there any certification requirements mentioned for the role?
qset.answer: Nothing as required. Preferred certifications include CompTIA, Microsoft, ITIL/HDI, Customer Service

qset.question: What cloud and enterprise technology experience is listed as a requirement?
qset.answer: Required cloud experience: Azure. Working knowledge and experience with other enterprise technologies such as MS 365, BMS Kaseya, ADO, Ticketing, Teams and Zoom, and Conference room technologies.

qset.question: What are some of the soft skills mentioned as important for the role?
qset.answer: Here are some of the mentioned ones: Strong organizational and communications skills, attention to detail, drive to solve issues with technology, customer-first mentality, work collaboratively with team members, critical thinking, and eagerness to learn and advance his/her career, ability to deal with multiple, competing objectives, ability to stay flexible and shift focus based on high priority items.
